title: 347 Squadron Halifax Memorial, Asten
memorial_details: A memorial at Asten, North Brabant, commemorating two Halifax III aircraft of No. 347 (Tunisie) Squadron RAF reportedly shot down by the same nightfighter pilot (named Fengler in local accounts) on a single sortie. No. 347 Squadron flew Halifax III aircraft from RAF Elvington from July 1944. The serial numbers of both aircraft and the full crew lists have not been confirmed from accessible sources. Dutch local aviation archaeology groups — in particular SLOD (Stichting Luchtoorlog Onderzoek Drenthe) and WW2 Research NL — are the primary sources for this type of record, but the relevant Dutch websites were inaccessible at the time of research.
crew_summary: Two full Halifax crews. Individual names, fates, and burial locations not yet confirmed.
